job.job_description:
NOTE : Job-related updates will be shared on the official Router Architects LinkedIn page:




https://www.linkedin.com/company/router-architects/





Role Overview

We are looking for a motivated Golang Developer (Fresher) to join our engineering team in Noida. This role is ideal for recent graduates or early-career developers who want to build strong backend development skills using Go (Golang).




You will work closely with experienced engineers to develop, test, and maintain backend services, contribute to scalable application design, and troubleshoot technical issues. The role also involves working with AI-assisted and agent-based development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, and testing. This position offers hands-on learning in microservices architecture, APIs, and modern backend systems in a collaborative environment.





Key Responsibilities:

Assist in developing and maintaining backend services using Golang

Support the design and implementation of APIs and microservices

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code

Debug and troubleshoot software issues

Participate in code reviews and technical discussions

Use AI-assisted development tools and coding agents to generate, review, and optimize code

Collaborate with the team to experiment with agentic workflows for faster development and debugging

Learn and apply backend development best practices





Required Qualifications:

B.E or B.Tech

Strong understanding of programming fundamentals

Knowledge of Golang or willingness to learn it quickly

Understanding of networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, HTTP, or MQTT

Basic familiarity with APIs and microservices architecture

Good problem-solving and debugging skills

Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment

Good communication and collaboration skills





Preferred Qualifications:

Internship or project experience in backend development

Familiarity with Git, Linux, or containerization tools

Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or ChatGPT

Interest in AI-driven or agent-based software development workflows

Relevant certification or coursework in software development
